thread:
mia: FYI seeing a burst of 429/soft-rejects from eu-west pools starting ~08:12 UTC. App teams report clients retrying aggressively and spiking cost.
raj: Was this during the scheduled capacity drain? I saw a maintenance job at 08:10 that pulled one node group.
mia: Not sure, but queue depth climbed fast. Sample admit header on one response: `X-RW-Admit: 0.22; X-RW-QueueDepth: 18; X-RW-Pool: eu-west-2a`
eli: Oof. Clients are doing linear backoff with no jitter. That's a big multiplier.
raj: We should tell SDKs to honor an `admit` float and compute retry windows. Something like: `retry_after = base * (1 / admit)` and add jitter.
mia: Agree. Also wondering if we can include a short-circuit hint for fallbacks: `X-RW-Fallback: allow-compact` when admit < 0.3.
infra-oncall: ops-bot logged automated shed at 08:11:03 for pool eu-west-2a, reason=maintenance, target_util=0.78. Rolling nodes out. See: https://internal.ops/evt/98321
ops-bot: Incident created: #98321 pool-eu-west-2 drain. Auto-notify to product teams.
eli: Proposal for SDK behavior (minimal):
```python
# pseudocode
admit = float(resp.headers.get('X-RW-Admit', 1.0))
if admit < 0.5:
    backoff = base_backoff * (1.0 / max(admit, 0.05))
    backoff *= random.uniform(0.8, 1.2)  # jitter
    # optionally switch to compact model if header allows
```
raj: Also suggest header `X-RW-QueueEstimate` that gives expected wait ms. Then clients can choose to reroute to hosted fallbacks or degrade features rather than blind retries.
mia: +1. Product teams prefer explicit ms estimate rather than opaque admit. Helps UX decisions.
infra-oncall: Note: region constraints matter — eu-west has limited spare GPUs this week due to dedicated reservations. We can't always promise queue drains quickly.
ops-bot: Suggest adding `X-RW-Priority-Hint: low|normal|high` acceptance in request so platform can bias admission in favor of business-critical traffic.
eli: For cost-sensitive customers we could include `X-RW-Cost-Mode: economize` to opt into quantized variants when admission low.
raj: Concern: adding too many headers increases surface area. Keep core ones: Admit, QueueEstimate, Fallback-Allow, and maybe Priority-Hint.
mia: Can eng-infra draft a short RFC + SDK PR template? Product will need example UX copy for degrade path.
infra-oncall: I'll draft RFC and include a simulation of client retry patterns + cost delta. ETA EOD.
eli: I'll draft a lightweight SDK change for JS + Py that implements admit-based jittered backoff and fallback header parsing.
raj: We'll also add a metric: `client_retries_per_429` to track amplification. If > 3x baseline, auto-trigger a recommended throttle policy.
mia: Thanks. Quick action item: inform active product owners on channels and add a temporary throttling rule to eu-west pools to cap new low-priority admits at 0.15 until maintenance completes.
infra-oncall: Done, rule applied at 08:18 UTC.
mia: Nice. Keep the thread updated if retries keep spiking. :thumbsup:
